title: Downsampling
text: Whole-slide patterns millions cells, many Lcross. functions reduce number points. take either n_target (number points) prop (fraction), return ppp attribute "downsample" describing done.
code: library(SpaFun) library(spatstat.geom) data(tcga_crops) pp <- tcga_crops[[1]] pp #> Marked planar point pattern: 20294 points #> Multitype, with levels =  #>    benign epithelial inflammatory necrotic neoplastic no label stromal #> window: binary image mask #> 462 x 462 pixel array (ny, nx) #> enclosing rectangle: [51732.79, 66513.58] x [14780.797, 29561.593] units

title: Downsampling
text: Wrapper: chooses method method accepts single ppp list samples. Lists processed parallel future.apply (choose backend future::plan()); results reproducible set.seed(). marks listed cell types kept; by_marks = TRUE type downsampled separately, n_target number cells per type.
code: library(spatstat.random) #> spatstat.random 3.5-2 set.seed(1) X <- rpoispp(2000) Y <- downsample(X, method = "uniform", prop = 0.1) attr(Y, "downsample") #> $method #> [1] "uniform" #>  #> $n_orig #> [1] 1971 #>  #> $n_kept #> [1] 197  # several samples, in parallel # future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 4) Xs <- list(a = rpoispp(2000), b = rpoispp(3000)) Ys <- downsample(Xs, method = "window", n_target = 500) sapply(Ys, spatstat.geom::npoints) #>   a   b  #> 505 504

title: Downsampling
text: Uniform random thinning. Independent thinning leaves K L functions (cross-type ones included) unchanged: method use Lcross.
code: library(spatstat.random) set.seed(1) X <- rpoispp(2000) spatstat.geom::npoints(downsample_uniform(X, n_target = 300)) #> [1] 300

title: Downsampling
text: Sampling probability proportional 1 / density. makes pattern homogeneous, changes K L: use visualisation, estimating Lcross. density computed pixel grid looked points, weighted sampling uses Efraimidis-Spirakis algorithm: half million points take second.
code: library(spatstat.random) set.seed(1) X <- rMatClust(20, 0.05, 100) Y <- downsample_KDE(X, prop = 0.2) spatstat.geom::npoints(Y) #> [1] 453

title: Downsampling
text: Keeps points inside randomly chosen square tiles n_target reached. window result union tiles, edge corrections stay correct; largest usable r gets smaller.
code: library(spatstat.random) set.seed(1) X <- rpoispp(2000) Y <- downsample_window(X, prop = 0.25) plot(Y)

title: Downsampling
text: real crop: L-cross function neoplastic stromal cells cells, uniform thinning KDE downsampling (20% cells type). Negative values L(r) - r mean two types segregated. Uniform thinning gives curve noise; KDE downsampling pushes towards 0, value homogeneous independent patterns, hides segregation.
code: set.seed(1) pp3 <- tcga_crops[["TCGA-EM-A1YA"]] r <- seq(0, 150, length.out = 50) lc <- function(x) {   spatstat.explore::Lcross(x, "neoplastic", "stromal", r = r,                            correction = "border")$border } pp_uni <- downsample(pp3, "uniform", prop = 0.2, by_marks = TRUE) pp_kde <- downsample(pp3, "kde", prop = 0.2, by_marks = TRUE)  curves <- cbind(all = lc(pp3), uniform = lc(pp_uni), kde = lc(pp_kde)) matplot(r, curves - r, type = "l", lty = 1, lwd = 2, col = 1:3,         xlab = "r", ylab = "L(r) - r", main = "TCGA-EM-A1YA") abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey") legend("topleft", colnames(curves), col = 1:3, lty = 1, lwd = 2, bty = "n")

title: FDA pipeline
code: library(SpaFun) library(data.table) library(fda) library(ggplot2) library(dplyr) library(tidyr)

title: FDA pipeline
text: input table column r_value one column per slide L-cross function (see “Lcross pipeline” vignette). HPC read disk: build 5 example crops tcga_crops, vignette runs anywhere. 5 curves analysis demonstration: full analysis uses TCGA slides.
code: input_file <- "/projects/shared/TCGA_data/results/combined_Lcross.csv"  message("Reading data from: ", input_file) dt <- fread(input_file) message("Successfully loaded data with ", nrow(dt), " rows and ", ncol(dt), " columns.") data(tcga_crops) r_values <- seq(0, 150, length.out = 70)  set.seed(10) subs <- downsample(tcga_crops, method = "uniform", n_target = 5000,                    marks = c("neoplastic", "stromal"), by_marks = TRUE) L_list <- lapply(subs, function(x) {   spatstat.explore::Lcross(x, i = "neoplastic", j = "stromal",                            r = r_values, correction = "border")$border }) dt <- data.table(r_value = r_values, as.data.table(L_list)) dim(dt) #> [1] 70  6

title: FDA pipeline
text: apply fsmooth function convert raw data points continuous functional data object.
code: message("Applying fsmooth function...") #> Applying fsmooth function... smoothed_Lfun <- fsmooth(dt, M = 6, genLfun.fd = 4, centered = FALSE)

title: FDA pipeline
text: perform Functional PCA smoothed LL-functions. number harmonics exceed number curves: use 3 5 example curves (10 full TCGA data).
code: # Run fPCA n_harm <- min(10, ncol(dt) - 2) fpca <- pca.fd(smoothed_Lfun$fd, nharm = n_harm, smoothed_Lfun$fdPar)  # Assign sample names (excluding the 'r_values' column) to the PCA scores rownames(fpca$scores) <- colnames(dt)[-1]

title: FDA pipeline
text: apply two clustering techniques scores first two principal components. full data look 6 groups; 5 example curves use 2.

title: FDA pipeline
code: # Set seed for reproducibility set.seed(123)  # number of groups: 6 on the full data, fewer with the example curves k <- min(6, nrow(fpca$scores) - 3)  # K-means clustering fpca_km <- kmeans(fpca$scores[, 1:2], centers = k)  # Hierarchical clustering (Ward's method) fpca_hc <- hclust(dist(fpca$scores[, 1:2]), method = "ward.D2") memb_hc <- cutree(fpca_hc, k = k)

title: FDA pipeline
text: distribution tables comparing cluster assignments methods.
code: message("K-means cluster sizes:") #> K-means cluster sizes: table(fpca_km$cluster) #>  #> 1 2  #> 2 3  message("Hierarchical clustering cluster sizes:") #> Hierarchical clustering cluster sizes: table(memb_hc) #> memb_hc #> 1 2  #> 1 4

title: FDA pipeline
text: visualize smoothed LL-functions, color-coded K-means cluster assignments. Function plot smoothed Lcross functions
code: plot_smoothed_Lfun(   smoothed_obj = smoothed_Lfun,    clusters_vec = fpca_km$cluster,    mark_i = "neoplastic",     mark_j = "stromal",   center_plot = TRUE      # Subtracts 'r' since centered = FALSE in fsmooth )

title: FDA pipeline
text: Finally, project compare sample distributions reduced PCA space using clustering results.
code: # Set up side-by-side plotting layout par(mfrow = c(1, 2))  # K-means plot plot(fpca$scores[, 1], fpca$scores[, 2], col = fpca_km$cluster, pch = 3, main = "K-means") abline(v = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey") abline(h = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey")  # Hierarchical clustering plot plot(fpca$scores[, 1], fpca$scores[, 2], col = memb_hc, pch = 3, main = "Ward.D2") abline(v = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey") abline(h = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey") # Reset layout par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

title: Lcross pipeline
code: library(SpaFun) library(spatstat.geom) library(spatstat.explore)

title: Lcross pipeline
text: ann2ppp() reads h5ad file uses PNG mask window. masks thumbnails 1.25x coordinates 40x, mask pixel 40 / 1.25 = 32 coordinate units. HPC, one slide: call small example file shipped package (holds small square slide, mask covers whole slide): next steps use larger example: crop slide cells, tcga_crops.
code: sample_dir <- "/projects/shared/TCGA_data/h5ad/TCGA-TS-A7P8-01Z-00-DX1.25E9AFA9-6C12-4F18-BE79-2F4F19887ECD.h5ad.gz" save_dir   <- "/projects/shared/TCGA_data/results/test"  file_name <- sub("\\.h5ad\\.gz$", ".rds", basename(sample_dir)) save_path <- file.path(save_dir, file_name)  mask_path <- sub("/h5ad/", "/mask/", sample_dir) mask_path <- sub("\\.h5ad\\.gz$", ".png", mask_path)  pp_object <- ann2ppp(sample_dir, mask = mask_path, magnif = 40,                      thumb_mag = 1.25, marks_col = "type") f    <- system.file("extdata", "tcga_tiny.h5ad", package = "SpaFun") mask <- system.file("extdata", "tcga_tiny_mask.png", package = "SpaFun")  if (requireNamespace("anndataR", quietly = TRUE)) {   pp_tiny <- ann2ppp(f, mask = mask, magnif = 40, marks_col = "type")   print(pp_tiny)   print(table(marks(pp_tiny))) } #> Marked planar point pattern: 1527 points #> Multitype, with levels =  #>    benign epithelial inflammatory necrotic neoplastic no label stromal #> window: binary image mask #> 2736 x 2896 pixel array (ny, nx) #> enclosing rectangle: [0, 92672] x [0, 87552] units #>  #> benign epithelial      inflammatory          necrotic        neoplastic  #>                33                29                 8              1313  #>          no label           stromal  #>                31               113 data(tcga_crops) pp_object <- tcga_crops[[1]] table(marks(pp_object)) #>  #> benign epithelial      inflammatory          necrotic        neoplastic  #>               492               323                86             16931  #>          no label           stromal  #>               528              1934

title: Lcross pipeline
text: Whole slides millions cells. keep neoplastic stromal cells reduce type separately uniform thinning, leaves L-cross function unchanged (see “Downsampling” vignette). HPC: example crop, smaller target:
code: set.seed(10) ppp_sub <- downsample(pp_object, method = "uniform", n_target = 40000,                       marks = c("neoplastic", "stromal"), by_marks = TRUE) set.seed(10) ppp_sub <- downsample(pp_object, method = "uniform", n_target = 5000,                       marks = c("neoplastic", "stromal"), by_marks = TRUE) attr(ppp_sub, "downsample")$n_kept_by_mark #>  #> neoplastic    stromal  #>       5000       1934

title: Lcross pipeline
text: HPC result slide saved disk:
code: r_values <- seq(0, 150, length.out = 70)  Lcross_neoStroma <- Lcross(   ppp_sub,   i = "neoplastic",   j = "stromal",   r = r_values,   correction = "border" )  plot(Lcross_neoStroma, . - r ~ r, main = "L-cross neoplastic - stromal") saveRDS(Lcross_neoStroma, file = save_path)

title: Lcross pipeline
text: functional analysis need one curve per slide, r grid, table column r_value one column per slide (input “FDA pipeline” vignette). downsample() accepts list patterns processes parallel future::plan() set. HPC, saved .rds files combined way:
code: set.seed(10) subs <- downsample(tcga_crops, method = "uniform", n_target = 5000,                    marks = c("neoplastic", "stromal"), by_marks = TRUE)  L_list <- lapply(subs, function(x) {   Lcross(x, i = "neoplastic", j = "stromal", r = r_values,          correction = "border")$border })  Lcross_table <- data.frame(r_value = r_values, L_list, check.names = FALSE) head(Lcross_table[, 1:4]) #>     r_value TCGA-05-4382 TCGA-CF-A8HY TCGA-EM-A1YA #> 1  0.000000            0    0.0000000            0 #> 2  2.173913            0    0.0000000            0 #> 3  4.347826            0    0.0000000            0 #> 4  6.521739            0    0.0000000            0 #> 5  8.695652            0    0.0000000            0 #> 6 10.869565            0    0.9650164            0 files <- list.files(save_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE) L_list <- lapply(files, function(f) readRDS(f)$border) names(L_list) <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(files)) Lcross_table <- data.frame(r_value = r_values, L_list, check.names = FALSE) data.table::fwrite(Lcross_table,                    "/projects/shared/TCGA_data/results/combined_Lcross.csv")

title: Downsample a spatial point pattern — downsample
text: pp ppp object, list ppp objects. method One "uniform", "kde", "window". n_target Number points keep. Mutually exclusive prop. list, either one value one value per pattern. prop Fraction points keep, (0, 1]. Mutually exclusive n_target. marks Optional character vector cell types (mark levels) keep; points dropped downsampling. by_marks TRUE, cell type downsampled separately n_target / prop apply type (e.g. n_target = 40000 keeps 40000 cells type). title: Downsample a spatial point pattern — downsample
text: ppp (list ppp, input names) attribute "downsample" describing operation.

title: Downsample a spatial point pattern — downsample
text: Methods: "uniform": random thinning, see downsample_uniform(). Leaves K L functions unchanged: recommended choice computing Lcross. "kde": inverse-density sampling, see downsample_KDE(). Makes pattern homogeneous: use estimate K L. "window": keeps points inside random tiles, see downsample_window(). Local structure intact, observed area shrinks.

title: Downsample a spatial point pattern — downsample
code: library(spatstat.random) #> Loading required package: spatstat.data #> Loading required package: spatstat.univar #> spatstat.univar 3.2-0 #> Loading required package: spatstat.geom #> spatstat.geom 3.8-3 #> spatstat.random 3.5-2 set.seed(1) X <- rpoispp(2000) Y <- downsample(X, method = "uniform", prop = 0.1) attr(Y, "downsample") #> $method #> [1] "uniform" #>  #> $n_orig #> [1] 1971 #>  #> $n_kept #> [1] 197 #>   # several samples, in parallel # future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 4) Xs <- list(a = rpoispp(2000), b = rpoispp(3000)) Ys <- downsample(Xs, method = "window", n_target = 500) sapply(Ys, spatstat.geom::npoints) #>   a   b  #> 514 506

title: Inverse-density (KDE) downsampling — downsample_KDE

title: Inverse-density (KDE) downsampling — downsample_KDE
text: pp ppp object, list ppp objects. n_target Number points keep. Mutually exclusive prop. list, either one value one value per pattern. prop Fraction points keep, (0, 1]. Mutually exclusive n_target. sigma Kernel bandwidth. Either number function takes ppp returns bandwidth. Default spatstat.explore::bw.scott(), fast large patterns. dimyx Resolution pixel grid used density estimate (passed spatstat.explore::density.ppp()). density computed grid looked points, keeps cost almost independent number points. ... arguments passed spatstat.explore::density.ppp().

title: Inverse-density (KDE) downsampling — downsample_KDE
